g.text: Accepted develop 2c98bed9 (rust) → candidate 459f7506 (blue). All22 players react normally; same frozen inputs and capabilities.
Native endings: K01 6.33 → 5.86yd; K04 5.37 → 6.13yd; Power 4.15 → 3.92yd. Ordinary tackles remain. No gain target or guaranteed collection.
Solid facing curves are achieved execution; dashed curves are current requests. Hand bars show sampled force, not an assignment or compression requirement.
K01 RT/Sam has no hand load; Sam never reaches the observed RB route. Force presence alone does not prove full route protection.
